text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri in the lead! Oguri in the lead!
Oguri in the lead!
Oguri crosses the line first! Oguri takes
first place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She raised her right hand—!
Truly! A super Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (I had—a dream.)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(I chased—a dream.
And now, I am—)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sharing the exact same dream with
everyone.
Monologue placeholder for SE.
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that should be enough packing... for
now, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
(Guess I'll be away from these school
gates for a while.
It feels like just yesterday that I first
arrived from Kasamatsu.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oguri-saaan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oguri-san, are you leaving?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, Ardan, Yaeno...
You came to see me off...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my absolute all racing against
you guys in the Arima Kinen.
So, combined with some training duties,
I've decided to rest in Hokkaido for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"With all my might... Yes.
I was able to witness that firsthand,
right up close."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—In the race, they shared the same
bracket, right next to each other)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
("Has Oguri Cap lost her edge?"
Some people spread such heartless rumors.
But seeing you right beside me...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
—Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"(That wasn't the expression of a
'washed-up' Umamusume at all.
She was radiating a brilliance I had never
seen before)"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I bore witness to that power myself. 2,500
meters is a bit long for me. Right in the
middle of being engulfed by the agony—
(WAAAHHHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming "aura"—bursting forth up
ahead.
Followed by a roar of cheers unlike
anything heard before.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you. I am certain it's you.
A life-saving fist that can shatter even
the direst of predicaments.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was truly made to understand what it
means to "run carrying everyone's dreams."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Me too. As I chased after her with every
ounce of my strength,
my tears just wouldn't stop. Because of
the sheer power I saw right before my
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"'I will definitely catch up to that back
I've always admired!
Our finishing kick speed is—dead even!!
WOOOOOAAAHH!!'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even driving myself until my whole body
felt like it was tearing apart... I
couldn't reach her. Perhaps it wasn't a
difference in strength, but the weight of
what we carried.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And then—that massive Oguri call.
You, who were unquestionably at the center
of that era...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's only for a short while, your
fans would be terribly lonely without you.
That is why—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san, would you like to perform a
concert?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A live concert...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the three of us talked it over. We
thought about holding a Special Live
to commemorate the season of fierce
ambition you charged through.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To share our gratitude with one another.
From the fans to Oguri-san,
and from Oguri-san back to her fans.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"A gratitude live, huh... That sounds
nice.
Still, if we're going through the trouble
of stepping onto the stage—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I want to do it with someone.
Would someone... stand on that stage with
me?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Who, ya ask?
Well, ain't that obvious!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My partner's gotta be Tamamo Cross!!
What is there even to think about?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, you worked real hard this year.
I'll do that stage together with ya.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Tama...
You're right, I feel like you really are
the one here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The performers are decided.
All that's left is organizing the event
itself, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leave that to me too!
I've got a lead in mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Planning Oguri-senpai's event... is that
it?
I'll do it! I'd love to, Tamamo-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, will you take the job, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I ran with both of them quite often.
I think my experience working various
events as a model will come in handy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea. I was thinking of setting
a project in motion for the main event.
As for the details—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's a "Call for Thank-You Messages" from
the fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A message of gratitude...? From the fans?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sure there are countless words
the fans
want to send to Oguri-senpai. With all
those gathered wordsâ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to bring color to the stage.
It will be a decoration far surpassing any
costume or stage set."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's amazing! If we could put on a
performance like that—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It will be an earth-shattering, marvelous
live performance.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right! That's all the preparations
taken care of.
Now then, Oguri, let's give it everything
we've got!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Tama. Let us show them our perfect
synchronization.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's convey our gratitude.
All the feelings that have grown... since
coming to Tracen Academy.
